title: Oktoberfest at The Continental Sorrento
summary: Conti Bar becomes a German beer hall from 15 to 22 October, with Weihenstephaner on tap and a Bavarian menu. Free entry.
priceRange: Free entry, food and drink at menu prices
recurrenceNote: Runs daily from 15 to 22 October; daily session times not stated on source
weatherDependency: Conti Bar and beer garden, largely covered
nearbyAttractions: Sorrento main street; Sorrento front beach
suggestedItineraryPairing: A long Oktoberfest lunch, then the walk down to the front beach
editorVerdict: Weihenstephaner and a Bavarian menu for a week, with no ticket at the door. Walk in, order a stein.
editorNote:
Conti Bar takes Bavarian styling for a week, with Weihenstephaner on tap and a German menu to match.

Entry is free, so it reads as a walk-in for a stein and a plate rather than a ticketed sitting. Daily session times are not published; check with the venue before you drive down for a particular day.
